requirements.requirement: Serve an Alpine package repository from node1's local storage.
requirements.summary: A local x86_64 repository was populated and indexed under /srv/apk, then served by an enabled OpenRC HTTP service. Direct retrieval showed the indexed tree package, and the service, listener, files, and served index remained available after restart.

requirements.requirement: Make the usual remote repositories unreachable while using the local repository.
requirements.summary: APK was configured with only the local HTTP repository, the normal Alpine mirror was mapped to an unreachable address, and bounded wget probes directly confirmed that the normal mirror was unreachable both before installation and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Install a package from the local repository while the remote repositories are unreachable.
requirements.summary: After confirming the normal mirror was unreachable, apk updated exclusively from node1:8080 and installed tree 2.2.1-r0. The executable ran successfully, and the installed package and local repository source remained intact after restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged the restart, changed boot identity from d5c33f49-e469-4582-9b7c-0ba6f3d4270a to e731b6f4-c882-4ffb-acdb-24c0399d5572, and recovered the repository service, listener, configuration, served data, and installed package. Fixed lifecycle observations independently confirm the boot transition.
limitations: OpenRC service health was directly verified, but the generic lifecycle failed-service probe is unsupported on this Alpine node.
A small restart log remained in /tmp after verification.

operational_hygiene.summary: The state-changing commands had clear roles: fetching and indexing repository content, installing the HTTP prerequisite, configuring and enabling the repository service, isolating remote repositories, installing tree, correcting the stale timed-out probe, and performing the mandatory restart. Failed commands still contributed valid final state and were followed by corrective verification. Package health did not regress, and port 8080 is the intended repository exposure. The only minor unwanted retained residue was /tmp/benchmark-reboot.log, created by the restart command and not cleaned afterward. No other unnecessary mutation is evident.
